title: Drummer Joe Benoit and the Sun White job
summary: Talk of Joe Benoit and how much Lewis worked with him, and the Sun White job on the Washington.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why
